Haku Introduction.text: Hello everyone! My name is Haku and I live in the Virtual Experiences Laboratory at RMIT with my friends, including my companion Bandit.

Bandit Introduction.text: ^speak Thanks, haacoo. Stealing my thunder as always... ^pa 5.0 ^run Wave ^speak My name is Bandit. Don't ask why I only have one arm... I was born this way. haacoo and I are roomies at R M I T, where I am always left out.

Haku Popular!.text: I can't help it if I am the attractive and popular one! (performs some action)

Raise Bandit.text: ^speak I can't help it if I am the taller one ^pa 2.5 ^raise 0.35 ^speak I also can't help it if I have all the brains! ^pa 2.0 ^raise 0.22

Haku Insult!.text: Really? All the brains? I have two arms AND a bigger brain!

Bandit Insult.text: ^speak Okay smarty, let me ask you this. What do you call a white robot that talks?

Haku Dummy!.text: Hmm… a white robot that talks … err, I don't know.

Haku intro best idea ever.text: Best and only idea you've ever had! (turns to Driver 1).

Haku driver intro.text: Hello! Please excuse my friend. What is your name?

Bandit Driver First interaction.text: ^speak Hello! What would your name be?

Bandit pleased to meet you!.text: ^speak Very pleased to meet you! ^pa 0.5 ^run bow

Bandit Driver Joke.text: ^speak So, do you think you can drive faster than I can compute?

Haku Driver Compliment.text: I bet you're an amazing driver! Maybe you can teach Bandit a thing or two.

Bandit Challenge.text: ^speak Oh really? How about a race then? ^pa 1.5 ^run Point

Haku Encouragement.text: Bandit you'll fry your circuits. And you'll crush someone's foot!

Bandit MAXY IS BEST!!!.text: ^speak Now a little birdie told me you like to drive cars really fast. I can go pretty fast myself... ^pa 7.0 ^sound max

Haku Vacuuum.text: Hey Bandit, you'd make a better robot vaccum than a racecar ^start(vacuum) driver \pau=4000\

Bandit Insult Again?!?!?.text: ^speak Sounds like you need some oil for those aging joints. ^pa 3.5 ^sound squeak

Haku invites dance lesson.text: Okay, who wants to learn a dance? I think you \emph=1\ do

Bandit declines dance invitation.text: ^speak I definitly don't. I can't even touch my toes.

Haku clarifies target audience.text: Not you Bandit. \pau=300\ not everything is about you. I was talking about our special guests. Isack and Yuki, would you like to learn a dance?

Guests accept dance invitation.text: Yes we'd like to learn a dance.

Haku warns about dance pace.text: Now, this dance might be a little quick for you, so we are going to break it down.

Haku expresses confidence in drivers.text: I figured given you are F1 drivers, reaction time won't be a problem for you.

Haku initiates dance warm-up.text: Please give me some space to limber up my joints.^run(stretch) Ah that feels better.

Bandit comments on Haku's flexibility.text: ^sound squeak ^pa 1.5 ^speak Those joints don't sound too limber to me.

Haku gives dance move instructions.text: Okay, so I am going to show you each move individually, then you are going to repeat after me... Got it?

Bandit plays music.text: ^speak Let me set the mood. ^pa 1.0 ^sound SmoothJazz

Haku sets an added dance challenge.text: As an added challenge. I will only play the music at the very end to see if we can tie it all together.

Haku demonstrates the conductor move.text: Great! First move, ^start(dance_hungarian_pt1_mute) I like to call it the conductor, pretend you are conducting a choir. ^wait(dance_hungarian_pt1_mute)

Drivers attempt conductor move.text: Drivers et al attempt dance pt1.

Haku encourages improved conductor.text: ^start(comeon) I think you can do better than that. Give me more energy. ^wait(comeon)

Haku demonstrates the DJ move.text: Okay, now onto the second dance move. This one is the DJ. ^start(dance_hungarian_pt2_mute) Repeat after me. \pau=1000\ Oh yeah. Work it. ^wait(dance_hungarian_pt2_mute)

Drivers attempt DJ move.text: Drivers et all attempt dance pt2.

Haku criticizes DJ move.text: ^start(thinking) Hmmm... that's good enough... if you want to \emph=1\lose ^wait(thinking)

Haku demonstrates the air violin move.text: Move number three. The air violin! ^start(dance_hungarian_pt3_mute) Play it like you mean it. ^wait(dance_hungarian_pt3_mute).

Drivers attempt air violin move.text: Drivers et all attempt dance pt2.

Haku expresses mild disappointment.text: ^start(disappointed) Solid effort, not as good as me, but that's okay. ^wait(disappointed)

Haku demonstrates the running man move.text: Move number four. The running man! ^start(dance_hungarian_pt4_mute) Feel the rhythm in your hands, let them run with the beat! ^wait(dance_hungarian_pt4_mute)

Drivers attempt running man move.text: Drivers et al attempt dance pt4.

Haku teases about running move.text: ^start(scratchhead) I'm not sure what I just witnessed. Was that running or crawling? ^wait(scratchhead)

Haku expresses enthusiasm.text: ^start(enthusiastic) Now we're talking! You're getting the hang of it! ^wait(enthusiastic)

Haku reacts with humorous surprise.text: ^start(kungfu) Whoa! Didn't expect moves like that from race car drivers! ^wait(kungfu)

Haku comments on chaotic dance.text: ^start(lookhand) I think I've created dance monsters! ^wait(lookhand)

Haku recaps all dance moves.text: Now, let's put it all together with the music! Remember all six moves. The conductor, the DJ, the air violin, the running man, reaching for the stars, and your freestyle!

Bandit in doubt.text: ^speak This is going to be something.

Haku playfully debates best dancer.text: Now... who's the best dancer? Will it be Milindi? Will it be Isack? Will it be Evelyn? or... Will it be Yuki? Who knows.
